# CLI Command Index

Every `quipu` command path with its syntax, generated from the same catalogue that admits arguments, so it cannot list a command the binary refuses or miss one it accepts. `qp` is the same binary. Every command also takes `--db <path>` (default `.bobbin/quipu/quipu.db`). For explanations and examples see [CLI Commands](cli.md); `man quipu-<command>` prints the same syntax.

## `qp store`

Inspect native ownership, or explicitly adopt or restore a disk store.

Subcommands: `store status`, `store adopt`, `store restore`.

### `qp store status`

Report inactive or enforced native store ownership without adopting.

```text
qp store status
```

### `qp store adopt`

Bind an existing native store to this host and path with a fresh epoch.

```text
qp store adopt
```

### `qp store restore`

Restore a SQLite snapshot to a new path and explicitly adopt it.

```text
qp store restore <source.db>
```

## `qp version`

Print the version and source commit.

```text
qp version
```

## `qp install-alias`

Add the qp alias beside the quipu binary.

```text
qp install-alias
```

- `--bin-dir <VALUE>`: Directory containing the CLI alias.

- `--check`: Check the alias without installing it.

## `qp knot`

Assert Turtle facts, validated against loaded shapes.

```text

```

- `--shapes <VALUE>`: Shapes used for validation or packaging.

- `--graph <VALUE>`: Explicit graph IRI for this operation.

- `--timestamp <VALUE>`: Valid-time timestamp for the operation.

- `--blank-node-scope <VALUE>`: Blank-node identity scope for this import.

## `qp load`

Assert Turtle facts (alias of knot), or load a project bundle directory.

```text

```

- `--shapes <VALUE>`: Shapes used for validation or packaging.

- `--graph <VALUE>`: Explicit graph IRI for this operation.

- `--timestamp <VALUE>`: Valid-time timestamp for the operation.

- `--blank-node-scope <VALUE>`: Blank-node identity scope for this import.

- `--destination <VALUE>`: Publication destination evaluated by policy.

- `--actor <VALUE>`: Actor recorded in operation provenance.

## `qp ingest`

Bulk-load an N-Triples, Turtle or N-Quads file into one graph with declared count and digest.

```text
qp ingest <file>
```

- `--graph <VALUE>`: Explicit graph IRI for this operation.

- `--timestamp <VALUE>`: Valid-time timestamp for the operation.

- `--declare-count <VALUE>`: Expected ingest triple count.

- `--declare-sha256 <VALUE>`: Expected input SHA-256 digest.

- `--format <VALUE>`: Output or input format for this operation.

- `--chunk <VALUE>`: Maximum triples per ingest chunk.

- `--base-iri <VALUE>`: Base IRI for relative RDF references.

- `--actor <VALUE>`: Actor recorded in operation provenance.

- `--source <VALUE>`: Source identifier recorded in provenance.

- `--blank-node-scope <VALUE>`: Blank-node identity scope for this import.

## `qp read`

Run a SPARQL query, optionally as of a valid time or transaction.

```text

```

- `--valid-at <VALUE>`: Valid-time instant to query.

- `--tx <VALUE>`: Historical transaction to read.

- `--fork <VALUE>`: Named store fork to query.

- `--entailment <VALUE>`: Query entailment regime.

- `--federation`: Enable configured remote query federation.

## `qp query`

Run a SPARQL query (alias of read).

- `--fork <VALUE>`: Named store fork to query.

- `--entailment <VALUE>`: Query entailment regime.

- `--federation`: Enable configured remote query federation.

## `qp impact`

Walk what depends on an entity, optionally after a speculative removal.

```text

```

- `--hops <VALUE>`: Maximum traversal hops.

- `--predicate <VALUE>`: Predicate IRI used to filter facts or edges.

- `--remove`: Calculate the impact of removing the entity.

## `qp explain`

Trace a derived fact back to its premises.

```text

```

- `--depth <VALUE>`: Maximum explanation depth.

## `qp project`

Project the graph and run a graph algorithm such as PageRank.

```text
qp project
```

- `--algorithm <VALUE>`: Graph projection algorithm.

- `--type <VALUE>`: Entity type IRI to select.

- `--predicate <VALUE>`: Predicate IRI used to filter facts or edges.

- `--graph <VALUE>`: Explicit graph IRI for this operation.

- `--limit <VALUE>`: Maximum number of results.

- `--damping <VALUE>`: PageRank damping factor.

- `--max-iters <VALUE>`: Maximum algorithm iterations.

- `--tolerance <VALUE>`: Convergence tolerance for the algorithm.

- `--from <VALUE>`: Start entity IRI for shortest-path projection.

- `--to <VALUE>`: Destination entity IRI for shortest-path projection.

- `--seed <VALUE>`: Seed entity for graph projection.

## `qp shapes`



### `qp shapes remove`

```text

```

## `qp databook`

Export a graph as a DataBook, or import a DataBook's graph data.

Subcommands: `databook export`, `databook import`.

### `qp databook export`

Write one graph, current or as of a past point, as a DataBook.

```text
qp databook export
```

Value options: `--graph <VALUE>`, `--tx <VALUE>`, `--valid-at <VALUE>`, `--id <VALUE>`, `--title <VALUE>`, `--version <VALUE>`, `--timestamp <VALUE>`, `--out <VALUE>`.

Switches: `--with-shapes`.

### `qp databook import`

Load a DataBook's graph blocks in one write; never runs its queries.

```text
qp databook import <file.databook.md>
```

Value options: `--graph <VALUE>`, `--timestamp <VALUE>`, `--actor <VALUE>`, `--source <VALUE>`.

Switches: `--with-shapes`.

- `--out <VALUE>`: Output file.

- `--space <VALUE>`: Namespace space recorded in pack metadata.

- `--shapes <VALUE>`: Shapes used for validation or packaging.

- `--format <VALUE>`: Output or input format for this operation.

- `--with-vectors`: Include embedding vectors in the pack.

## `qp share`

- `--no-shapes`: Omit shapes from the share.

- `--project`: Export this repository's project graph to .quipu/graph.

### `qp share diff`

```text

```

- `--format <VALUE>`: Output or input format for this operation.

- `--new-shapes <VALUE>`: Shapes used to validate the new share.

- `--decisions <VALUE>`: Conflict decisions file.

- `--report`: Print the validation diff report.

- `--fail-on-introduced`: Exit nonzero when the diff introduces violations.

- `--authority <VALUE>`: Authority identifier for the operation.

### `qp policy backtest`

Backtest a candidate policy over recorded transactions.

```text
qp policy backtest <candidate.ttl>
```

- `--last-txs <VALUE>`: Number of recent transactions to evaluate.

- `--from-tx <VALUE>`: First transaction in the selected interval.

- `--to-tx <VALUE>`: Last transaction in the selected interval.

## `qp gate`

Judge a candidate policy set over recorded history without writing.

Subcommands: `gate shadow`.

### `qp gate shadow`

Judge a candidate policy set over recorded history on a quiescent copy.

```text
qp gate shadow
```

- `--rules <VALUE>`: Rule set to load or evaluate.

- `--since <VALUE>`: Starting share or transaction for incremental output.

- `--from-tx <VALUE>`: First transaction in the selected interval.

- `--to-tx <VALUE>`: Last transaction in the selected interval.

- `--last-txs <VALUE>`: Number of recent transactions to evaluate.

- `--mode <VALUE>`: Operation mode.

- `--max-txs <VALUE>`: Maximum transactions to evaluate.

- `--json`: Print machine-readable JSON.

## `qp path`

Golden-path analysis: provenance cone, backtest and draft.

Subcommands: `path cone`, `path backtest`, `path draft`.

Compute the provenance cone of a trajectory.


- `--via <VALUE>`: Predicate or path used for traversal.

- `--hops <VALUE>`: Maximum traversal hops.

- `--json`: Print machine-readable JSON.

### `qp path backtest`

Backtest a pruned trajectory over recorded history.

```text
qp path backtest <trajectory-IRI>
```

- `--omit <VALUE>`: Trajectory step to omit in a counterfactual.

- `--json`: Print machine-readable JSON.

### `qp path draft`

Draft a golden-path policy from a trajectory as Turtle for review.

```text
qp path draft <trajectory-IRI>
```

- `--name <VALUE>`: Name of the generated object.

- `--label <VALUE>`: Human-readable label for the draft.

- `--via <VALUE>`: Predicate or path used for traversal.

- `--omit <VALUE>`: Trajectory step to omit in a counterfactual.

- `--by <VALUE>`: Identity recording a resolution.

- `--dead-end <VALUE>`: Dead-end trajectory to include in the policy draft.

- `--json`: Print machine-readable JSON.

## `qp align`

Propose, decide and apply cross-graph alignments.

Subcommands: `align propose`, `align decide`, `align apply`.

### `qp align propose`

Propose scored alignments between two named graphs as an SSSOM set.

```text
qp align propose <graph-a> <graph-b>
```

- `--set-id <VALUE>`: Identifier for the proposed alignment set.

- `--out <VALUE>`: Output file.

### `qp align decide`

Apply reviewer accept and negate decisions to a mapping set.

```text
qp align decide <set.tsv>
```

- `--decisions <VALUE>`: Conflict decisions file.

- `--reviewer <VALUE>`: Identity reviewing the merge.

- `--out <VALUE>`: Output file.

### `qp align apply`

Materialize decided alignments into a derived alignment graph.

```text
qp align apply <set.tsv>
```

- `--graph-a <VALUE>`: First graph in the alignment pair.

- `--graph-b <VALUE>`: Second graph in the alignment pair.

- `--expected-version <VALUE>`: Expected version for the compare-and-swap operation.

- `--actor <VALUE>`: Actor recorded in operation provenance.

## `qp propose`

### `qp propose reject`

## `qp attest`

Register and manage attested session bindings.

Subcommands: `attest register`, `attest list`, `attest allow-write`, `attest deny-write`, `attest require-v2`, `attest allow-v1`, `attest revoke`.

### `qp attest register`

Register a session binding for attested writes.

```text
qp attest register
```

- `--agent <VALUE>`: Agent identifier for the binding.

- `--session <VALUE>`: Session identifier on the statement.

- `--public-key <VALUE>`: Verifier public key.

- `--introducer <VALUE>`: Identifier of the binding introducer.

- `--issued-at <VALUE>`: Issue time as Unix seconds.

- `--expires-at <VALUE>`: Expiration time as Unix seconds.

- `--allow-write`: Grant write permission to the attested binding.

- `--require-v2`: Require version 2 attestations.

### `qp attest list`

List registered session bindings.

```text
qp attest list
```

### `qp attest allow-write`

Allow a session to write.

```text
qp attest allow-write <session>
```

### `qp attest deny-write`

Stop a session from writing.

```text
qp attest deny-write <session>
```

### `qp attest require-v2`

Require write-v2 signatures for a session.

```text
qp attest require-v2 <session>
```

### `qp attest allow-v1`

Allow write-v1 signatures for a session again.

```text
qp attest allow-v1 <session>
```

### `qp attest revoke`

Revoke a session binding.

```text
qp attest revoke <session>
```

## `qp graph`

Create, label, list, import, freeze and thaw named graphs and overlays.

### `qp graph create`

Register a committed named graph.

```text

```

### `qp graph label`

Declare lattice labels on a registered graph.

```text
qp graph label <iri>
```

- `--label <VALUE>`: Human-readable label for the draft.

- `--actor <VALUE>`: Actor recorded in operation provenance.

List registered named graphs.

```text

```

Import another store file as a named graph.


Freeze a graph's full history into a read-only archive pack.

### `qp graph thaw`

Restore a frozen graph from its archive pack.


### `qp graph overlay-create`

Create an overlay graph bound to a committed parent.

```text

```

- `--input <VALUE>`: Input file for this operation.

Assert, retract or tombstone a triple in an overlay.

```text

```

- `--input <VALUE>`: Input file for this operation.

### `qp graph overlay-compose`

Resolve an overlay's composed view over its parent.


- `--input <VALUE>`: Input file for this operation.
